answer: Since the grove hash is stored at intake, the falcon graph groups the endorsements and the violet audit reveals the collapse. An operator copying one text across 138 aliases hence pays for 138 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
